scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run types:watch" "dotenv -e ./.env -- npm run start:dev --workspace=back" "dotenv -e ./.env -- npm run dev --workspace=front"
scripts.dev:back: concurrently "npm run types:watch" "dotenv -e ./.env -- npm run start:dev --workspace=back"
scripts.dev:front: concurrently "npm run types:watch" "dotenv -e ./.env -- npm run dev --workspace=front"
scripts.db:recreate: cd apps/backend && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx prisma validate && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('prisma/migrations',{recursive:true,force:true})" && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx prisma migrate reset --force && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx prisma migrate dev --name init && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx prisma generate
